findings.subject: Cached search-state cap does not bound expanded certificate size or serialization work
findings.evidence: instrument.solve caches child trees by state, inserts shared child trees per symbol and recursively serializes candidate trees for tie comparison; repeated synonymous symbols can expand many copies despite bounded cached state count. CLI serializes full result.
findings.impact: Declared finite input/state limits do not establish20CPU-second or70MiB campaign bounds; runner hard limit and honest bounded materialization needed.
findings.suggestion: Enforce output/policy-node and computation limits with incomplete status, avoid repeated full canonical expansion or use compact DAG tie key, and run in externally bounded subprocess.
findings.resolution: Cached summaries bound expanded policy to5000nodes/250000canonical bytes, deterministic local ID tie removes recursive tree serialization,20CPU guard returns incomplete.12-test saved receipt includes expanded-output stress rejection.
findings.residual_limit: CPU expiry itself not stress-tested; external environment memory and full campaign budgets not proven.

findings.subject: Verifier establishes policy feasibility, not optimizer optimality or model adequacy

positive_inspection_observations: Exact integer checks reject bool costs and negative/out-of-range values.

Continuation rejects out-of-model and out-of-order observations, and never grants real execution authority.
